common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished high-fidelity screenshot of a redesigned Settings screen for Socially, a mobile Solana social investment app for Crew and Captains. This is a design proposal image, not source code.
Input images: image 1 is the current Crew Home, image 2 is the current Wallet. Both are STYLE AND BRAND references only. Design an entirely new SETTINGS layout, not a copy of their portfolio content.
Output: one flat, edge-to-edge mobile app screenshot, portrait 1024x2208 (a 393x852 logical viewport), no device frame, no presentation board, no annotations outside the app, no multi-screen collage, no watermark. Entire page fits one viewport, nothing clipped and no scrolling implied.
Brand: luminous pearl background #F5F7FB; deep navy #182B43/#0D274B ink; slate #547196 secondary text; icy blue frosted surfaces #F0F9FF to #DDEEFA with fine white rims, pale blue hairline borders; subtle shadows; 22–24px logical corner radius. Cormorant Garamond for selected editorial headings, Inter for clear UI. Restrained coastal voyage identity. Outline utility icons, consistent thin navy strokes. Do not use neon, purple, gold ornament, noisy glass reflections, or excessive decorative cards.
Real content: page title "Settings". User "Vikas Kumar", handle "@vikaskumar", small "Crew" role marker. Small pale blue avatar with navy initials "VK" (use this identity consistently). Profile has "Edit profile" action. Main existing destinations: "Account", "Display", "Invite a friend", "Help & support", "About Socially". Legal links "Terms" and "Privacy". Quiet "Log out" action in muted burgundy #A3333F. Small app version "v1.0.0". Keep these existing destinations present or clearly accessible through the specified tabs/groups.
Optional actual preference only when requested below: "Hide wallet balances" with a small toggle OFF; read-only appearance value "Light voyage", language "English", currency "USD". Never add rewards, verification, subscription, 2FA, seed exports, trading permissions, fake financial numbers, notifications settings, developer panels, or invented security status.
Mobile usability: 20px logical side margins, 15–16px logical menu labels, 44–56px tap-height controls, balanced whitespace. Compact identity; no enormous profile hero. Do not reduce typography excessively to fit content. No explanatory paragraph under each menu item.
Critical shared bottom navigation IN EVERY proposal: about 32px above bottom edge, inactive white/pearl rounded "Home" pill LEFT with outlined house and slate "Home"; a separate white/pearl rounded capsule RIGHT containing THREE icons only, outlined compass, outlined wallet, and gear. Gear is selected in a navy filled circle with a white gear. Other icons blue-gray. Never select wallet or Home. No labels beneath right icons. All settings content must end above this navigation with generous clear gap.
The layout concept below is essential: follow its unique hierarchy and containment, not a generic settings screen. Render all text cleanly and accurately.

concepts.name: Compact groups
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 01: Compact grouped lists. A modest left-aligned Inter Settings heading, then a shallow frosted horizontal profile strip (VK avatar left, two lines name/handle center, tiny Crew chip and Edit profile on right). Two white rounded list groups: first exactly Account and Display, each 54px with navy outline icons and chevrons, one fine dividing rule. Second exactly Invite a friend, Help & support, About Socially with matching 54px rows. No artwork at all. Under groups, one quiet horizontal footer Log out left, Terms and Privacy right, v1.0.0 centered below. Main content anchored to top with relaxed bottom whitespace. Composition should feel extremely simple and practical.

concepts.name: Six-tile grid
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 02: Symmetric icon grid. Settings title top-left. A small centered circular VK avatar, Vikas Kumar, @vikaskumar and small Crew chip, subtle Edit profile text below; whole profile about 125px high. Below, six equal frosted white/blue action tiles in TWO columns by THREE rows, each about 96px high with a tidy outline icon at upper left and label at lower left. Tile labels: Account, Display, Invite a friend, Help & support, About Socially, Privacy. No chevrons on grid. Centered understated Log out below grid; Terms and v1.0.0 as compact low footer. All within one screen, use clear breathing room between tiles, grid not big isolated floating icon buttons. No large scenic banner.

concepts.name: Editorial ledger
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 03: Open editorial ledger with no enclosing cards. Settings is a beautiful navy Cormorant serif title, 36px logical size. Thin horizontal rule. Compact profile is left VK avatar, Vikas Kumar and handle, Crew at right, and Edit profile right-aligned below identity. Navigation is a single OPEN list directly on pearl canvas, five roughly 55px rows Account, Display, Invite a friend, Help & support, About Socially. Each uses a tiny outline icon, crisp Inter label, slim right arrow, and a full fine blue-gray bottom rule. No rounded menu containers, no icon wells, no background art. Tiny serif Socially wordmark on lower left with v1.0.0; Log out on lower right; Terms and Privacy small links below. Precise typography and ample horizontal space create quiet editorial character.

concepts.name: Frosted hub
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 04: One unified frosted panel. The pearl page has a very faint blue sea texture ONLY within a shallow 70px top band, with Settings title below the safe inset. One SINGLE large rounded translucent icy-blue glass panel occupies middle of viewport. Inside it, compact horizontal VK identity header, name and handle, Crew chip, Edit profile link. Hairline divider separates identity from five menu rows Account, Display, Invite a friend, Help & support, About Socially; 51px logical row heights with small outline icons and chevrons. The bottom of this same glass panel contains a separated quiet Log out row. No nesting cards inside the panel. Terms, Privacy and v1.0.0 outside underneath on a clean pearl footer. Strong single-surface coherence, soft frosted daylight, keep all content visible.

concepts.name: Navy identity
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 05: Navy identity card and compact controls. Settings heading small Inter at top. A shallow horizontal navy #182B43 profile card about 105px tall: pale-blue VK avatar left, white Vikas Kumar and light handle in middle, small subtle Crew pill, Edit profile at lower right; faint nautical contour lines only on card right, no illustration. Below, ONE white card with Account and Display as two 55px rows. Below that, TWO side-by-side shallow icy blue cards for Invite a friend and Help & support, each 80px tall and small outline icon. Below these a slim open About Socially row with chevron. Bottom footer: Log out, Terms, Privacy, v1.0.0 clearly separated from nav. Distinct dark profile anchor, predominantly pearl screen, no other dark card and no big scenery.

concepts.name: Tabbed preferences
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 06: Tabs eliminate long scrolling. Small Settings heading top left. Slim horizontal profile identity strip with VK, Vikas Kumar, @vikaskumar, Crew and Edit profile. Then a three-part pill segmented control with exactly "Account", "Display", "More"; DISPLAY is selected with subtle icy blue fill/navy text. Visible selected Display tab has a serif "Preferences" subheading; one white rounded panel with direct toggle row "Hide wallet balances" OFF, then read-only paired rows "Appearance" / "Light voyage", "Language" / "English", "Currency" / "USD". Tiny "More" section below with two outline text shortcuts Invite a friend and Help & support and a separate About Socially link, so core destinations remain understandable. Footer has quiet Log out, Terms, Privacy, v1.0.0. Do not use chevrons on read-only values. Layout feels like a deliberate compact tabbed inspector, not a generic full settings list.

concepts.name: Mixed action layout
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 07: Hybrid of wide account and asymmetric feature tiles. Settings uses serif heading aligned left; compact profile identity appears as an open row right below with VK, name, handle, Crew, Edit profile. Full-width shallow white Account button, icon and label left and chevron right. Then a two-column block: LEFT is a tall 160px pale blue "Display" tile with outline eye icon at top, direct small "Hide balances" toggle OFF at bottom; RIGHT consists of two vertically stacked 76px white tiles "Invite a friend" and "Help & support", small outline icons and arrows. Below, full-width open About Socially row. Bottom carries a tidy single line Terms and Privacy with v1.0.0; Log out separately above. No scenic artwork. Asymmetry makes Display immediately useful while keeping navigation compact and all visible.

concepts.name: Expandable groups
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 08: Minimal accordion groups, one expanded. Compact Settings title and 80px open VK identity row, name, handle and Crew; Edit profile is inside the expanded Account group below. Four stacked rounded white accordion sections: "Account" EXPANDED with upward chevron and two compact child rows "Edit profile" and "Sign-in & session". Then "Display" collapsed with downward chevron; "Community" collapsed with small inline secondary words "Invite · Support"; "About Socially" collapsed with small inline secondary words "Terms · Privacy". Main group labels are clear and 16px, child rows 44px high, collapsed groups each 60px high. Soft frosted blue tint highlights Account expanded header only. No illustrations. Separate modest Log out row and v1.0.0 below. Clearly an elegant progressive-disclosure system, spacious one-screen view, not an endless list.

concepts.name: Privacy first
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 09: Immediate preference first, paired open links. Settings top left and tiny VK avatar at upper right. Below heading, compact name Vikas Kumar, @vikaskumar, small Crew pill, Edit profile link; no enclosing profile card. First prominent but shallow icy blue panel 88px high: eye-slash outline icon, label "Hide wallet balances", one short secondary line "Keep amounts private", OFF switch right. Then a compact TWO-column, TWO-row set of open divided menu cells (no individual card borders): Account and Display in first row, Invite a friend and Help & support in second row; each cell uses small outline icon + Inter label. Below a full-width simple About Socially row. Quiet Log out and legal footer Terms · Privacy and v1.0.0. Large clean blank breathing area below, typography-led, no scenic artwork. This is preference-centric, distinct from six-tile grid or stacked lists.

concepts.name: Coastal index
concepts.direction: LAYOUT 10: Coastal two-zone index. Top safe area and Settings serif title on pearl. A slim pale-blue scenic coastal sailboat artwork strip only 85px tall, rounded 20px; VK identity is a compact white inset horizontal strip laid across the LOWER edge of artwork, Vikas Kumar, @vikaskumar, Crew and Edit profile, no tall centered avatar. Then TWO equal-width tall frosted columns side by side, about 210px tall. LEFT column headed "You" in serif with open link rows Account, Display; RIGHT column headed "Socially" in serif with open link rows Invite a friend, Help & support, About Socially. Each row is 44px touch height with tiny right arrow, allow Invite a friend and Help & support to wrap neatly if needed; modest outline icons above column headings only. No generic grid of square tiles. Beneath columns a small white horizontal utility rail: Log out left, Terms and Privacy right; v1.0.0 centered below. Layout uses thematic compact artwork and a two-zone information architecture, strong one-screen clarity.
